rules.statement: The appellants did not have the money with them to pay the respondent on February 6, 1940.
rules.supporting_quote: It is clear that on the receipt of the letter dated February 5, 1940, at 2 P.M. the Proctor of appellant No. 2 would have known that the respondent was not in Colombo and would not be back in Colombo until the 11th. It was impossible for him, therefore, to receive the money from the office of appellant No. 2 at the specified time on February 6, 1940, as required by the letter of that date.
